author: MunchReviews
quote: Honestly just because GTA fans are review bombing both Ocarina of Time and Ocarina of Time Remake, I’m review bombing GTA6, this is a good game but it ain’t no Grand Theft Auto game

author: MunchReviews
quote:
Now this is how you do a remake people, this brings in an established game and elevates on it, making an already exceptional game into an even more exceptional game, everything about this remake is incredible from the visuals, to the music, to the gameplay, it’s incredible to be playing through, and I’ll admit, I’ve always thought the original Ocarina of Time (even though it is incredible and revolutionary) was a bit overrated, but as I play through this remake, I understand now. Phenomenal job Nintendo, now please do Majoras Mask!

10/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
